'''Huulia''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Huulia system/Legends|Huulia system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] whose [[Exhaust Nacelle/Legends|exhaust nacelle]]<ref name="CL" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="32 BBY">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'', 2005 edition]] establishes that [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] owned an [[Exhaust Nacelle/Legends|exhaust nacelle]] from a Huulian [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> had ended up in the possession of the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CL" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]] [[Homeworld/Legends|grew up]] as a roughneck [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Youngling/Legends|kid]] on Huulia. As a teenager, he traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by hiring on to [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="3 ABY">{{Film|V}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], depicts the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]].</ref> he had joined the offworld [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Huulia was introduced, in the form of the name of a Huulian starfighter, in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> The celestial body was first established as such by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Huulia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Huulia itself, in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
